		<description>At 20:48 on November 3, 2026, the meteorological observatory of Lin an District, Hangzhou City issued a gale yellow warning signal: it is expected that there will be 6-8 gusts in Longgang, Changhua, Daoshi, Qingliangfeng, Tianmu Mountain, the Taihu Lake Lake and other towns (streets) in our district from tonight to tomorrow. Please pay attention to prevent the adverse effects of gales on outdoor tourism, facility agriculture, and projects under construction.</description>
		<instruction>1. The government and relevant departments should pay timely attention to the dynamics of warning signals and carry out emergency measures to defend against strong winds in accordance with relevant regulations; 2. Safety precautions should be taken for construction sites, airports, ports, and other transportation facilities. Personnel in dangerous areas should evacuate in a timely manner and stop high-altitude operations; 4. Personnel should try to minimize going out and properly place window sills, balconies, and outdoor storage items.</instruction>
